snippet.title: Silver Pines   Team17
snippet.description:
Step into the eerie quiet of the town of Silver Pines, WA. You are Red Walker. You wake in a diner with no memory of how you got there. As you explore this small, seemingly abandoned place you’ll discover something has gone horribly wrong, and you’ll be pulled into a web of mystery, betrayal and horror.
Silver Pines blends survival horror and metroidvania-style exploration with scarce resources, atmospheric rotoscope ­animated action and a town full of secrets waiting to be uncovered.  ￼

Wishlist it on Steam and keep your eyes open for updates — the shadows are moving in Silver Pines.
